title: Pomofocus Session Focus Minutes Leaderboard
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pomofocus:session focus_minutes=*
| stats sum(focus_minutes) as total_value, avg(focus_minutes) as avg_value by project_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks project name values by total and average focus minutes across Pomofocus session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `focus_minutes` values for each Pomofocus session event and review total and average focus minutes by project name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total focus minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which project name shows the biggest focus minutes numbers in your Pomofocus session data.
